title: Bind public Agora operational readiness to authoritative live truth
summary_zh: 移除未綁定的 process-global readiness default，改由 request-time read-only providers 讀取 active paper RuntimeBinding、Source 最新 snapshot/instance、canonical signal_generation consumption receipt，以及 tenant/user scoped Agora surface counts；所有缺失、例外、過期、future timestamp 與 snapshot mismatch 均 fail closed。

owned: source snapshot/source-instance and producer consumed-snapshot binding
typed fail-closed reasons and deployment identity readback
focused live-binding tests and this review evidence
composes_with: Runtime Manager desired-state and RuntimeBinding detail GET contracts
Source latest-market-snapshot and source-management GET contracts

operational_readiness_readback.surface_result: all seven unavailable with count=0 and reason=upstream_unavailable

producer_contradiction_input.enqueue_signature: repeatedly enqueues one real signal for the active paper binding

corroborating_repository_evidence.accepted_observation: paper-signal-producer was healthy, discovered one active paper binding, and enqueued one signal for it
corroborating_repository_evidence.qualification: The older diagnostic corroborates the producer log signature only; it rolled back and is not claimed as current release proof.

current_workflow_observation.qualification: This later failed candidate was compensated to the accepted baseline; its log is supporting runtime continuity evidence, not acceptance of that candidate.

implementation.exact_head_binding: The governed review handoff freezes REVIEW_PR and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA after the final evidence commit; this manifest cannot self-reference its containing commit.
contracts: Production wiring uses bounded Runtime Manager GETs, Source ingest GETs, and a bounded SELECT of the newest 200 canonical signal_generation telemetry rows.
Producer status is healthy only when the unique active paper binding has a recent canonical receipt whose market_input_snapshot_id exactly equals the current Source snapshot_id.
Missing or non-unique binding/source instance, stale or future timestamps, provider exceptions, and snapshot mismatch return typed fail-closed reasons.
Authenticated counts are tenant/user scoped; public counts exclude private records; readiness remains public and requiredForAuthentication=false.
No readiness provider receives or invokes an Agora mutation port.

details.warnings: Existing Starlette/FastAPI/jsonschema deprecation and duplicate-operation-id warnings only.

required_exact_pair.backend: the reviewed merge commit containing this task
required_exact_pair.frontend: the accepted execute-plans dev commit at deployment time

required_proofs: frontend deployment.json and public /bff/version identify the same newly accepted exact backend/frontend pair
container producer health is healthy with failing streak zero and one unique active paper binding
Source latest snapshot and source instance identity match the readiness source object
readiness active_binding and consumed_snapshot_id match canonical signal_generation metadata for that exact binding and current snapshot
all seven readiness surface counts equal direct scope-equivalent owner-store queries
public readiness remains non-auth-critical and an authenticated probe preserves tenant/user-private filtering

required_checks: verify get_read_store is consumed and no injected provider is unused
verify all owner calls are read-only and no mutation port is reachable
verify current Source identity, unique active paper binding, and canonical consumption receipt must agree before status=ok
verify stale, missing, mismatched, future, and provider-exception evidence fails closed
verify tenant/user-private surface filtering and exact deployment identity
verify focused tests and approve only the exact PR head frozen by governed handoff
